document.pages: General ordering data; Dimensions; General data; Version; linked drawing and photograph

modelingNotes: S1 identifies the exact order as a size-8 cover for the upper housing, with side-locking clamp on the lower side and no cable entries.

S2 drawing and S3 photograph were visually reviewed: mechanical cover, latches and retention tether; no contact insert or identified electrical terminals. The tether eye is not modeled as a PE terminal or fixed electrical bond.
IP65 applies in plugged condition; limit temperature -40 to +125 °C. No electrical current or voltage rating is assigned to the cover.
Zero-terminal accessory/documentation view. Host housing and insert connections and bonding are outside this cover identity.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical hood cover only: no identified power, return, PE/bond, shield, signal or communication terminals, required connections or fixed electrical links. Retention hardware does not establish electrical continuity; host assembly bonding is separate.

COVER.connector: Size-8 HDC hood cover, side-locking clamp on lower side
COVER.description: Mechanical attachment only; no electrical pins. COVER is an authoring alias, not a manufacturer terminal marking.
